manifest.name: idea-01-v1-understeer
manifest.description: Per-platform steady-state understeer correction over KS baseline. yaw_rate = v*delta / (L_eff + K_us*v^2). x,y integrated from yaw_rate and measured v with midpoint heading.

TESLA_MODEL_3.note: No truth in sim/ for Tesla — using mean K_us across labeled platforms.
